description: HTTPS is an extension of HTTP used for secure communication over a computer network.
real_world_incidents: Heartbleed vulnerability exposed memory contents over HTTPS connections globally.

audience_guidance.student: HTTPS ensures your data is encrypted, but the website itself could still have flaws.
audience_guidance.developer: Configure web servers to use modern TLS standards and strong cipher suites.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Review certificate details, check for weak ciphers via SSLlabs/testssl.sh, then focus on app layer.
audience_guidance.pentester: Test for downgrade attacks and weak encryption; focus primary efforts on web application vulnerabilities.
audience_guidance.security_team: Automate certificate renewal and continuously scan for non-compliant TLS configurations.
